note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-2 Ural-4320-02 service manual, seventh edition, 1992. The manual publishes the payload, the curb and gross mass, the road speed, the turning radius, the fording depth, the maximum gradient, the range, the engine and its ratings, the manual gearbox and its gear count, the final-drive ratio, the tyre size code and the tyre pressure at grade documented. It publishes no overall length, width or height in the held text pages, so those three fields are retained from the tier-5 English Wikipedia article at grade claimed. The manual covers the -02 family; the figures recorded name that variant.
